# 613: Ekspertenes porteføljer i tredje kvartal 2026

**Feed**: pengepodden-no  
**Published**: 2026-10-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian podcast episode (Dommedagens time) reviewing the hosts' portfolios for Q3 2026. Roger, who was absent, leads at +33%, ahead of Oslo Børs at +22%. Else is up about 11% with a defensive, diversified Oslo Børs portfolio, and Bjørn-Erik is up 6.8% after rotating into contrarian value names (Europris, Kinnevik, H100, Hafnia, Meta). The tone is constructive: high oil prices from the Hormuz conflict, a strong shipping cycle and a seasonal salmon-price thesis, set against bank and real-estate weakness, the SaaS sell-off and takeover bids (Elmera).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 EPR — Europris | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host added in summer. Trades ~80 NOK vs ~100 NOK sum-of-parts for the Norway business alone; the Sweden expansion comes for free.

#### Reasoning

Bjørn-Erik (host) holds 12.5% and added after a 10-15% YTD fall. He values the Norwegian operations at ~100 NOK/share, so the ÖoB Sweden rollout is a free option. High inflation favours discount retail, but he says the numbers need to show it. A patient long-term hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the ÖoB Sweden expansion keeps failing
- if the Norway business underdelivers versus the sum-of-parts value

> *"hvis du regner inn den Norge-eksponeringen, så er det verdt ca. 100 kroner aksjer"*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bought after a ~40% YTD fall; trades at ~0.5x estimated underlying value. The host calls it speculative.

#### Reasoning

Host thesis: the market prices 'death' into the SaaS/health portfolio after the AI-driven SaaS sell-off. At about half the real value, a small upside surprise or value realisation (asset sales) could rerate the stock. He admits portfolio valuation is uncertain and he could be wrong.

#### Sell Triggers

- if portfolio companies are written down further
- if there is no value realisation from asset sales

> *"den er priset ca. på halvgang i reell verdi i aksjemarkedet"*

---

### 🟢 HAFNI — Hafnia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

~7% position on a diesel shortage thesis; expects product-tanker rates to catch up with crude tankers.

#### Reasoning

Diesel above 30 NOK/litre in Norway and shortages at ~10-11% of French stations support product-tanker demand. The host expects the gap between VLCC and product-tanker rates to narrow. He also sees it as a geopolitical hedge, though much is already priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Hormuz conflict resolves and freight rates fall
- if the diesel shortage eases

> *"jeg tror at det gapet mellom stortank ... vil bli litt snevrere med produkttank"*

---

### 🟢 MOWI — Mowi | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Bought heavily in summer, expecting a seasonal salmon-price rise toward Christmas and new export markets (China).

#### Reasoning

The host bets on salmon prices rising into Christmas for the 7th year running and on growing distribution to China as US tariffs bite. He acknowledges a guest's bearish view on rising costs, commoditisation and biological risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if salmon prices fail to rise into Christmas
- if costs and biological issues escalate

> *"jeg tror i hvert fall at det kommer til å gjøre det igjen"*

---

### 🟢 META — Meta | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Both hosts bought after a ~15% post-earnings drop. MetaMuse launch news moves the stock; high volatility.

#### Reasoning

Bought the dip after earnings and it has worked so far. The hosts note weaker governance and higher volatility than other megacaps, so it is a more risk-seeking position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MetaMuse controversies escalate
- if there are governance problems

> *"så kjøpte jeg jo Meta, når de leverte tall, da var de ned rundt 15%"*

---

### 🟡 MSFT — Microsoft | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Rebounded strongly after Q results; the host took partial profit but kept the position, now his 2nd largest.

#### Reasoning

After a poor first half, the stock rallied over 20% on earnings. Bjørn-Erik trimmed but still holds it as a core position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if earnings momentum reverses

> *"jeg tok litt gevinst, jeg så ikke ut hele posisjonen min"*

---

### 🔴 PARB — Pareto Bank | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Both hosts exited due to weak results driven by real-estate exposure and low construction activity in Oslo.

#### Reasoning

Very poor numbers driven by property exposure and few new builds in the Oslo region. Bjørn-Erik and Else both sold.

> *"de har levert kjempedårlige tall og da tok jeg konsekvensen av det og kvittet meg med den"*

---

### 🟡 AKRBP — Aker BP | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Else holds: capex pays off in 2027+, oil ~$100, and strategic reserves need refilling. She would buy more on oil dips. Bjørn-Erik sold.

#### Reasoning

Else (host) sees years of capex turning into cash flow and dividends from 2027. Oil stays elevated because SPRs must be rebuilt after the Hormuz conflict. She would reconsider at $150 oil, while Bjørn-Erik argues oil stocks stall above $100.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil spikes to ~$150 with euphoric pricing
- if the Hormuz resolution collapses oil prices

> *"jeg synes ikke tidspunktet er helt riktig enda å kvitte meg med den"*

---

### 🟡 MPCC — MPC Container Ships | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Else trimmed after a ~500% gain because the position exceeded 8%; shipping is late in a strong cycle.

#### Reasoning

Taking profit on a big winner (5 to 28 NOK) and capping position size UCITS-style. The shipping cycle is strong but mature.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the container shipping cycle turns down

> *"jeg tok ned andelen litt og tar rett og slett litt profit"*

---

### 🟢 PROT — Protector Forsikring | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Else bought a good deal more as a defensive insurance case focused on commercial customers.

#### Reasoning

It complements Gjensidige and Storebrand's private-customer exposure. A defensive position in a diversified portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the combined ratio deteriorates

> *"kjøpt en god del mer protektor forsikring, faktisk, jeg mener at det er et veldig godt defensivt case"*

---

### 🟢 TEL — Telenor | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Else's largest position (7.2%); she added in summer. Investors are rotating into defensives.

#### Reasoning

A core defensive holding that she added to. Other investors are also rotating from oil and gas into defensive names like Telenor.

> *"jeg kjøpte en del Telenor i sommer"*

---

### 🔴 ELMRA — Elmera Group | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 80%

Fortum bid 47 NOK with 90% acceptance; Else is tendering because a delisting is likely.

#### Reasoning

With 90% acceptance, Fortum will likely squeeze out and delist, so holders should accept the offer.

> *"da må man svelge unna den"*

---

### 🟡 VEI — Veidekke | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Very robust contractor with steady contracts. Doubled since purchase, high dividend yield.

#### Reasoning

It survived the contractor bankruptcy wave, executes projects well and is supported by public-sector projects. Else views it as a stable support position.

#### Sell Triggers

- if public project flow dries up

> *"Veidek har vist seg å være vanvittig robust"*

---

### 🟡 AFG — AF Gruppen | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

A good support in Else's portfolio, with steady new contracts.

#### Reasoning

Doing well on the exchange despite small-contractor bankruptcies, helped by public-sector projects.

> *"Veidek og AF-gruppen, det dure på"*

---

### 🟢 BRG — Borregaard | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Else added after the stock fell.

#### Reasoning

She is concentrating the portfolio into preferred names and bought the dip.

> *"litt mer borregård som har falt litt"*

---

### 🟡 KOG — Kongsberg Gruppen | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Roger's long-held position, up ~800%. Investors are buying it as a defensive.

#### Reasoning

Bought around Russia's invasion of Ukraine and held; it keeps rising. This is the hosts' description of Roger's holding.

> *"Det er jo 800 prosent siden"*

---
